name: flow-oem-v1
description: Frozen OpenEarthMap benchmark for mask-conditioned flow-matching checkpoints. The protocol holds out whole city groups (hash-ranked by seed), generates from their masks with per-sample fixed seeds, and scores mask adherence with the frozen 2026-06-28 VAE-fused segmentation study checkpoint as the judge. Targets are the current competitiveness bar toward DiffusionSat-class satellite generation. Only the eval-defining fields (manifest_path, split, seed, samples, image_size, segmentation_checkpoint_path) gate comparability via the eval hash; never edit those in place - copy this file to flow-oem-v2.json instead. The sampler fields (generation_steps, guidance_scale, precision, batch_size) are defaults for the system under test: runs may vary them, they are recorded per run and shown on the leaderboard, and results stay comparable because what matters is performance however the model achieves it. Training runs must exclude the benchmark holdout; get the exclusion list with `sim-satellite benchmark --holdout-only benchmarks/flow-oem-v1.json` and copy it into the training config's validation_holdout_patterns.

targets.label: Frozen segmenter recovers the conditioning mask from generated images (mIoU)
Generated-image mIoU relative to the segmenter's own real-image mIoU
Paired SSIM against held-out real images from the same masks
Per-class RGB mean error between generated and real images
Edge sharpness mismatch at semantic boundaries
